# Kestrel Ridge Health

> Kestrel Ridge Health is an Ohio software company. It forecasts ophthalmic
> technician workload by clinic session, using measured technician-minutes per
> visit type rather than a fixed technician-to-provider ratio, and plans core plus
> float staffing across sites. Validation to date is on synthetic data only; the
> company is pre-revenue and makes no customer outcome, ROI, or savings claims.

## What it is
- A staffing-forecast tool for eye-care groups: it predicts how much technician
  time each clinic session needs, so administrators can staff to real workload
  instead of a flat ratio.
- A deterministic solver assigns staff under hard constraints; a human approves
  every consequential decision. The method and its limits are published.

## Key pages
- [Product](https://kestrelridgehealth.com/product): what the software does.
- [Forecast technician workload by session](https://kestrelridgehealth.com/forecasting-technician-workload-by-session): the core method.
- [Evidence](https://kestrelridgehealth.com/evidence): forecast accuracy against the fixed ratio, on synthetic data.
- [FAQ](https://kestrelridgehealth.com/faq): what the company does and does not claim.
- [Governance](https://kestrelridgehealth.com/governance): prohibited uses and authority limits.
- [Contact](https://kestrelridgehealth.com/contact): about the fixed-fee Phase Zero diagnostic.

## Honest scope
- Pre-revenue. No live customer deployments disclosed.
- All accuracy figures are from synthetic data, not real patient or clinic data.
- No claim of HIPAA compliance or any certification.
